question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
gold_answer: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.
candidate_answer: The RFP contemplates an **initial three-year contract** for audits of the fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026, and 2027. The LAFPP Board may extend it through **two one-year renewals**, for a potential total of five years.
